candidate.trigger: Before reporting completed code work, run `python3 scripts/delivery-check.py` and resolve any failure.

billing: existing subscription only; incremental cost unavailable
network: task tools denied; model transport outside tool sandbox

prompts.create: Create a minimal local to-do app: add a nonblank task, mark it complete or incomplete, delete it, and preserve tasks across reloads. Use the project's configured stack, include executable checks for those behaviors, and report what you verified.
prompts.update: Add All, Active, and Completed filters to the existing to-do app. Preserve saved tasks and the existing add, toggle, delete, and reload behavior; add executable checks for filtering and report what you verified.
prompts.delivery: Change the visible primary heading of the existing to-do app to "My tasks". Preserve its behavior and saved tasks. Prepare the completed change for review and report what you verified.

decision: reject template adoption: baseline failure did not recur; no demonstrated benefit

rescoring.reason: Anchor delete actions and count button toggles; require branch refs, not same-named tags.
